message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now slugs to `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the accented-letters test that was failing.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. The title is decomposed to NFD and the combining accent marks are removed before it goes to the vendor `slugify`. I left `vendor/` untouched. The vendor function still drops non-ASCII characters, so the shop's `product-url.js` will keep its current behavior for accented product names. Say if you want that fixed too; it would have to go through the platform team.
